== Research Notes ==
Note <span id='N1998'>N1998</span>. 

'''•''' If Thomas RAMAGE was her 2nd son, her father might have been Thomas MURRAY, but there’s a 5-year gap between Archibald and Thomas, so maybe another boy died before Thomas was born -- as 3rd son, Thomas would likely be named after his own father, Thomas.
Don’t find a Jane RAMAGE born in the 1770s or 1780s in the 1851 census in Lanarkshire, but there was one b. 1798 in the Upper Ward, Lanarkshire..

== Research Notes ==
=== Possible Jane Murray of Omagh ===
A marriage notice published on 5 September 1786 names Jane Murray of Omagh, aged sixteen, as bride of James Glasco, an Omagh publican aged sixty-one.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/1050075355/ The Public Register, or, Freeman's Journal, 1786-09-05, p.3].</ref>

Her reported age suggests birth about 1769–1770. The notice names no parents and gives no exact marriage day or subsequent history. A later marriage to a different husband is not by itself proof that she was a different woman.

This may concern [[Murray-8292]]. The approximate 1770 birth is compatible with Jane’s reported age. Her recorded marriage to [[Ramage-410|Thomas Ramage]] does not establish an Omagh or Glasco connection; a remarriage remains possible.
